groups.defect: Pairing error_ids with nodestore results by position can associate an error ID with another event's data.
groups.rationale: All four report the same positional zip assumption. Reordering, duplicate IDs, and missing entries are alternative triggers for that defect; lookup by node ID resolves them.

groups.defect: Time-field validation uses truthiness instead of presence for mutual exclusion and also permits reports with neither age nor timestamp.
groups.rationale: Both report the truthiness defect in the same validators. s_0f836d52 additionally reports acceptance when both fields are absent, which must survive in the merged comment.
